title: Localization of the explicit closed-fibre ring transitions
statement: Let X be a Noetherian local model tower [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower], and let A,B,phi be its explicit quotient functors and quotient stage maps [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-local-model-tower-fiber-system]. For every arrow f:i to j, endow B_i and A_j with their A_i-algebra structures from phi_i and A(f). There exist q:B_i tensor over A_i with A_j to B_j and a denominator submonoid U such that q(b tensor a)=B(f)(b)*phi_j(a), and B_j is a localization at U with algebra map q.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00R7, paragraph beginning with the colimit of the maximal ideals, quotient systems before the second use of Tag 00R6; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00R7.

proof.text:
For a transition i to j, let g : T_i tensor over S_i with S_j to T_j
and U be the localization supplied by X.fibreTransition. The commuting quotient
square defines a ring homomorphism q : B_i tensor over A_i with A_j to B_j,
with q(b tensor a) = image(b) * phi_j(a), by the tensor universal property.
The three quotient maps give P : T_i tensor over S_i with S_j to
B_i tensor over A_i with A_j. It is surjective: lift both factors of a pure
tensor to quotient representatives, then use additive induction on tensors.
The square consisting of g, P, q and the quotient map T_j to B_j commutes,
as checked on pure tensors and then by additive induction.

The image in the source of the extended maximal ideal of S_j lies in ker(P),
since its image in A_j is zero. Its image under g is the extended maximal
ideal in T_j, by the formula g(1 tensor a) = algebraMap(S_j,T_j)(a) and
transitivity of extension of ideals. Hence ker(T_j to B_j) is contained in
the extension of ker(P) along g. Apply IsLocalization.of_surjective to this
square, its two surjective quotient maps and that kernel inclusion. It gives
IsLocalization (U.map P) B_j with precisely the constructed q as algebra map.
The argument uses no flatness and also applies to identity transitions.

proof_origin.note: Detailed Lean argument refining the quotient-system paragraph of Tag 00R7.

lean.statement: theorem NoetherianLocalModelTower.fiber_localization {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {S' : Type w} {M : Type t} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Algebra R S] [Algebra S S'] [Module S' M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower S S' M] (X : NoetherianLocalModelTower R S S' M) : letI := X.preorder letI := X.commR letI := X.commS letI := X.localR letI := X.algRS letI := X.addN letI := X.moduleS let A := X.fiberA let B := X.fiberB let φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i := X.fiberφ (∀ (i j : X.ι) (f : i ⟶ j), letI := (φ i).toAlgebra letI := (A.map f).hom.toAlgebra ∃ (q : B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j →+* B.obj j) (U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[A.obj i] A.obj j)), (∀ (b : B.obj i) (a : A.obj j), q (b ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] a) = (B.map f).hom b * φ j a) ∧ (letI := q.toAlgebra; IsLocalization U (B.obj j)))
